description: Policy and rationale: docs/development/dependencies.md (Automated dependency updates).

packageRules.description: Group stable web/server runtime updates for manual review; provider SDKs and Tauri keep their own audits and groups.
Only patches of 0.x runtime packages join routine web updates; minor releases require approval below.
Review Android library updates together, leaving Gradle, Kotlin compiler and SDK/toolchain migrations separate.
Group bridge module updates without changing the Go language or toolchain directives.
Group Rust patches for manual review; Tauri retains its coordinated npm/Cargo groups and 0.x minor upgrades stay separate.
Automerge non-major devDependency updates once every check passes. 0.x packages stay manual because their minor releases may break.
Group and automerge non-major GitHub Actions updates and digest pins.
Initial Action digest pins freeze already-floating references; aging the newest matching release can leave the whole group unpinned indefinitely. Version and digest updates retain the cooldown.
Workflow runtime versions (node-version, go-version, toolchain) are deliberate; CI runs at the supported Node floor.
pnpm overrides are security pins; a major can escape the parent's declared range (fast-uri must stay 3.x for ajv).
Keep Tauri plugins moving together across npm and Cargo. Core Tauri is grouped by monorepo:tauri.
Claude Agent SDK refreshes follow topics/provider-refresh.md and update yepAnywhere.claudeCode.claudeAgentSdkVersion; request them from the Dependency Dashboard.
The optional STT pixi environment is held to a known-good snapshot and is not exercised by CI; request updates from the Dependency Dashboard.
Major migrations are requested deliberately from the dashboard, not opened as routine weekly PRs.
Pre-1.0 minor releases can break compatibility; request them deliberately and keep them out of routine groups.
